name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'MX Rock'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘MX Rock’ showcases sedimentary streaks of brown and grey throughout a breathable Primeknit upper in a dark charcoal finish. The sock-like build is equipped with traditional lace closure and a webbing pull tab affixed to the heel. Cutting across the sneaker’s lateral side, a post-dyed monofilament stripe offers improved breathability. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a fully caged Boost midsole, visible through cutaway detailing in the rubber outsole.
